spans.text: It is a quiet morning, and the only sounds audible outside are the chirping of the birds and the rustling of curtains in the wind.
You yawn and stretch under the comfortable covers. There's nothing urgent on the schedule that you have to finish this morning. You can sleep as long as you like.
No. The truth is, there is one important thing you need to do.
You know that very well, but you keep wanting to put it off.
After sighing into the warm darkness under the covers, you get out of bed and arrive at the table where your clothes are piled up.
Hm?
There is a plate of dried shredded squid beside your neatly-folded clothing.
You can tell at a glance that the plate is the one made from the block of wood that Tae gave you. After all, Junko was the one who helped paint the patterns on it.
Something's not right...
You take a pinch from the heaped pile of dried shredded squid and carefully sniff it—
It's fresh. It isn't giving off any strange odors, and it's the kind that Tae would immediately stuff into her mouth.
So what is it doing here?
Tae has an extremely keen sense of smell, and she could enter your room if she wanted to.
You have no idea how this plate of dried shredded squid has managed to survive for so long and even less idea why it is here.
Tae? Are you there?
You try asking, but as expected, there is no response.
Thus, you put on your clothes and leave the room in search of Tae.
You look in every nook and cranny of the mansion, but Tae doesn't seem to be here. Perhaps she's gone out for a stroll.
You return to your bedroom and stare at this mysterious plate of dried shredded squid.
Are you imagining things, or has the pile shrunk?
The dried shredded squid lies on the wooden plate as it smiles tauntingly at you and remains stubbornly silent.
All you can do is shake your head and pack what little luggage you have.
Yes, this is your most important objective at the moment—
You ought to be returning to the Griffin base.
Your destination was clear from the moment this journey began. All that's left is your choice of methods for reaching it.
You put your freshly-folded clothes beside a few important personal items, and then you take out the suitcase Franchouchou has prepared for you from below the bed.
Once it's all packed up, it will become your homecoming luggage.
But why is your suitcase so heavy?...
Wait a minute...
An idea flashes through your mind and you seize onto it.
You gently put down the suitcase and slowly open the zipper. Then—
Whoosh—
Gah... Ahhh... (She seems to be greeting you.)
I knew it!
Go on, tell me, where have you hidden my actual luggage?
Urghahh... Umumu... (She has an innocent look on her face.)
Defeated, you sit beside the suitcase and watch Tae as she carefully gathers up the dried shredded squid she has stashed inside it.
It was like this the last time too...
Back then, you had a pack on your back and were about to visit a friend of Yugiri's that she had introduced to you.
Ahhh... Urghhah... (She sounds surprised. Perhaps she's asking why you're here.)
Oh, it's you, Tae.
You look at the bag she's holding. It probably contains the ingredients for tonight's dinner. Looks like Tae is running errands today.
It must be hard running all over the place. Go on, Yugiri must be waiting for you.
Tae stares dumbly at your backpack and you get the feeling she thinks there's food inside. Thus, you smile and open your backpack for her to inspect.
Take a look. There's nothing delicious in there. It's just my luggage.
Urghuu... Uuahh? (You can tell that she's asking a question.)
Hm? You want to know why I'm carrying my luggage?
I'm looking for a way home, Tae. I'll be going back home someday.
Tae stares dumbly at you, and you realize that what you just said might have been too complicated for her.
It's okay if you don't understand. I'll explain it all to you when I get back tonight.
You sling your pack onto your back and begin looking for the address Yugiri has given you. However, your backpack becomes heavier and heavier...
Tae, stop biting my backpack!
Mmmuu... Uuuahhh... (It's a mix of garbled speech and vigorous head-shaking.)
I need to go ask people for information; you should head on home!
Uumuuu... (She adamantly refuses to do so.)
Fine then! I won't give up either this time!
You force yourself to drag your backpack, and Tae—who has firmly latched onto it with her jaws—along with it. Your pace does not slow down even when passers-by stare at you in shock. At least, until—
Until your strength is spent and Tae excitedly drags you back to the mansion.
From then on, it seems that Tae's been especially mindful of your actions.
You say "seems" because you don't have any proof of this, only that you seem to encounter her more often, and she's more willing to speak to you.
Erkurgh... Uuurgh... (Her tone is serious and forthright. She's probably lecturing you.)
Hm?
Confused, you look at Tae who's gesticulating at you, then at the plate of dried shredded squid on the table, and then at the suitcase.
What are you trying to say?
You dig out your Tae notebook and try to make sense of it.
Ten minutes later, you slowly begin to understand.
Tae, are you saying that since I accepted your dried shredded squid, I should allow you to curl up inside my suitcase?
Umm... Oahhh! (She lights up and gives you a thumbs-up.)
Fine, fine, you win...
You sigh, then with a smile, you hand her the plate of dried shredded squid that she has put on the table.
Here, it's for you.
Nom. (She devours the dried shredded squid in your hand in one gulp.)
Hold the plate yourself, or do you expect me to feed you?
Uuu... Ahumm... (She looks expectantly at you.)
Tae doesn't take the plate. Instead, she takes a little strip of dried shredded squid and brings it to your mouth.
Are... are you feeding me?
... (She stares blankly at you.)
Don't mind if I do, then. Thank you, Tae.
You gratefully eat the little piece of dried shredded squid.
No, Tae, I didn't touch a single bit of that squid...
Urghah... Oaahhh! (She frantically goes for the dried shredded squid.)
Right, take it, I don't—
Tae darts up to the table and grabs the plate, then in the next second, she's back by your side, grabbing you by the throat...
(Chokes)
Oaaahhhh...! (She holds the plate of dried shredded squid up high.)
Mmmmfff...! (Stop! Are you trying to shove the entire plate into my mouth?!)
Tae stops moving, and you're about to breathe a sigh of relief when you see her gently put the plate down and carefully pick up a strand of dried shredded squid between her fingers.
Then, she slowly places it in your mouth...
Oah... Ahh... (She looks a little smug now.)
All you can do is chew on the strand of squid in your mouth with mixed feelings.
You can have the rest.
Nk yhoo! (She expresses gratitude.)
Are you thanking me...?
Omnomnomnom... (She munches on the dried shredded squid contently.)
After watching her wolf it down, you relax as well.
You shift your attention from your stuffed travel pack to your empty suitcase.
You know that you'll leave this place, but not today, or perhaps not even tomorrow.
Since you're going to leave someday, why not take advantage of this opportunity to enjoy all the good things around you right now?
Tae, let's go to the supermarket to get you some snacks.
Cock-a-doodle-doo—!
Tae puts down the cleaned plate and jumps up happily.
And thus begins a plain, ordinary afternoon with a bit of commotion.
